## AI-Generated Fix (php)

```php
<?php

// Deny access to .env file
if (preg_match('/\.env$/', $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'])) {
    header('HTTP/1.0 403 Forbidden');
    exit('Access denied');
}

// Existing CodeIgniter index.php code continues...

// Load the framework bootstrap file
require_once BASEPATH.'core/CodeIgniter.php';

```

---

## Explanation

The vulnerability was due to the .env file being publicly accessible, which can expose sensitive configuration data. The fix involves adding a check at the beginning of the PHP script to deny access to any request that attempts to access the .env file directly. This is done by checking the request URI and returning a 403 Forbidden response if it matches the .env file pattern.
